CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Decay.cs:17) == `is_playable = False`. No Ethereal or Eternal on either side.

HasTurnEndInHandEffect.rationale: `=> true` (Decay.cs:19) == the class attribute -- ported here, unlike card/debt's.

ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to Math.Max(0, ...) on both sides, so only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: the ported cost readers all filter `> 0` or skip `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim inlines 2 at the damage site (decay.py:38)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new DamageVar(2m, ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move)` (Decay.cs:15) is a printed var with no `_damage` in `_init_vars`, so `Card.base_damage` returns None. The PROP SET is nonetheless right: the sim passes no explicit props and `DamageCmd.deal` infers `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` (UNPOWERED | MOVE) from `is_unpowered = True` (cmds.py:44-50, decay.py:27), so the 2 damage is not Strength-scaled and IS blockable on both sides -- identical to card/burn. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity (the dealt/applied number is identical), LIVE for the observation encoder.

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Damage, this)` (Decay.cs:28) -- passing the VAR, so the Unpowered|Move props ride along -- == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, 2, dealer=None, card=self)`. Explicit null dealer on both sides. No Cmd.Wait and no VFX on this one, so the bodies are step-for-step identical.

OnPlay.rationale: Decay.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable.
